tob-0038-d2: Church Committee Book II covers the FBI and CIA’s spying on Americans — the report on domestic intelligence work. It documented COINTELPRO and the watch kept on dissenters. The 1975 report remains the key record of home-front spying abuse. No other report covers this ground.
tob-0039-d2: This roll of microfilm keeps a slice of the Doctors’ Trial record at Nuremberg — the trial of Nazi physicians for war-time medical crimes. Day by day, the court heard proof and pleas. The record is a key source for the history of the trials.
frus-1943-cairo-tehran-d2: President Roosevelt to Marshal Stalin, May 5, 1943 — Document 2 in the FRUS Cairo-Tehran volume. The wartime correspondence between the Allied leaders. The message is the alliance: the president, writing to the marshal.
